defective_pattern: Employing aggregate document-level boolean assertions (e.g. any(), len() > 0) in validation scripts and downgrading critical domain violations (e.g. English words in Persian academic text) to non-blocking warnings.
why_defective: Document-level aggregate metrics mask localized failures, allowing unformatted tables or untranslated prose to pass into production deliverables without detection.
observed_symptoms: Aggregate boolean assertions passing while individual tables fail
English words present in Persian tables without triggering validator failure
corrective_remedy: Enforce strict per-item fail-closed iteration: every individual table must satisfy exact header whitelists and have full symbol definitions in its note; any English word outside allowed statistical symbols must trigger a hard FAIL verdict.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Inspect validation scripts for any(), all(), or non-blocking warning downgrades on critical invariants.
